name: Single-agent Carboplatin (attenuated / palliative)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT gentle single-agent option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Carboplatin is moderately emetogenic; give per emetic-risk framework.

premedications.name: Hypersensitivity awareness
premedications.notes: Carboplatin hypersensitivity rises with repeated platinum exposure; premedicate/desensitize as needed.

supportiveCare: For frail patients not fit for a doublet: single-agent carboplatin is a lower-toxicity option; individualize the AUC target to marrow reserve and renal function.
Thrombocytopenia is the characteristic dose-limiting toxicity.
monitoring: renal function / estimated GFR before each cycle (Calvert dosing)

drugs.name: Carboplatin
drugs.notes: Carboplatin AUC 5 IV on day 1 every 21 days (Calvert formula; attenuate to AUC 4 for frailty/poor marrow reserve) as a single agent for patients not fit for a platinum-taxane doublet. Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
